clauses.label: sole paragraph
clauses.text:
By virtue' of the authority vested in 
me by the Constitution and the statutes 
of the United States, it is hereby ordered 
that Executive Order No. 9139 of April 
18, 1942, establishing the War Manpower 
Commission in the Executive Office of the 
President, be, and it is hereby, amended 
to include in the membership of the said 
Commission a representative of the Na­
tional Housing Agency and a joint rep­
resentative of the War Shipping Admin­
istration and the Office of Defense 
Transportation.
